a.lede: Nvidia’s cofounder and chief executive resigned on Thursday after the company opened an investigation into his affair with an alleged Chinese intelligence asset.
a.title: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO

b.lede: Nvidia's board of directors reportedly approached Rene Haas, chief executive of Arm and a long-time Nvidia veteran, in CEO search.
b.title: Nvidia board reportedly approached Arm CEO Rene Haas during replacement search
